# 1 Clement Chapter 19 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 19 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_019_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 19

**19:1** The humility and willing obedience of all these great, attested men has been a blessing — not just to us, but to every generation before us that received God's words in reverence and honesty.

**19:2** Since we share in so many magnificent accomplishments, let us press on toward the target we were given from the beginning: peace. Let us lift our eyes to the Father and Creator of all that exists. Let us hold tightly to his wonderful, incomparable gifts — peace and kindness.

**19:3** Let us see him with the eyes of our minds. Let us reflect on his patient, unhurried will. Let us consider how remarkably slow to anger he is toward everything he has made.

---

*PNEUMA renders as a transitional bridge toward the cosmic meditation of Chapter 20.*
